worldcombat.skill.terablast.summary: Crystallize yourself into a Tera shard: the higher offense decides the form — a ram that knocks the target back or a beam — and the damage takes your primary type.
Deals about %1$s Tera energy damage; the type is your own primary type.
Attack minus Sp. Atk is %1$s: when Attack is higher it crystallizes into a ram (physical, knocks the target back); otherwise it fires a beam (special).
worldcombat.skill.terablast.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.terablast.preference.a: Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to cast Tera Blast; when off it stays put.
Fires the ram or beam within %1$s blocks; it shatters on the first enemy it meets for a single hit, and fizzles without damage if it strikes terrain.
